## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-4: Unit tests written and passing

## Implementation Notes
Create plugins/dso/scripts/label_visual_corpus.py with:
- validate_fixture(path) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]: checks fixture directory has screenshot.png, design_manifest.json (with attribution_class), and labels/ subdirectory. Returns (True, []) on pass, (False, errors) on fail.

Create tests/visual_eval/test_corpus_schema.py with:
- test_valid_fixture_passes: staged valid fixture → (True, [])
- test_rejects_missing_files: missing each required file in turn → (False, non-empty errors)

Add .test-index entry: plugins/dso/scripts/label_visual_corpus.py:tests/visual_eval/test_corpus_schema.py

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] validate_fixture returns (True, []) for well-formed fixture and (False, errors) for malformed
  Verify: pytest tests/visual_eval/test_corpus_schema.py -v
- [ ] .test-index entry added
  Verify: grep -q 'label_visual_corpus.py' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet)
